title: Shared definitions — NLU Bundle format 3.0 (ADR-005)
description: Common $defs referenced by every schema in this format version. Stable identifiers per ADR-001.1 §5: ids, never indices.

stableId.description: Stable identifier grammar (ADR-005 stage 10): lowercase dotted segments, e.g. 'audio.volume.set'.

intentId.description: Intent id in the domain.object.action taxonomy (roadmap §2.3).

formatVersion.description: Bundle format version: integer major.minor (ADR-005 Part 8).

portableRegex.description: A pattern in the portable regex subset (spec/bundle/portable-regex.md). Subset conformance is proved by compiler stage 10, not by this schema.

runtimeFeature.description: Closed feature-flag vocabulary for format 3.0 (ADR-005 Part 3/Part 12). Extended only by a format minor bump.
